code_blocks.content: <!-- Mobile keypad fixed: max 6 letter columns, thumb-sized keys, half-width Backspace/Play. --><style>  .keypad{display:none;margin-top:14px;width:100%;overflow:hidden}  .keyRow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(44px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}  .keyRow.short{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(44px,1fr))}  .key{height:48px;min-width:44px;padding:0;border-radius:12px;background:#1f2937;font-size:17px}  .key.utility{height:54px;font-size:18px;background:#475569}  @media(max-width:760px){    .keypad{display:block}  }  @media(max-width:420px){    .keyRow{gap:7px;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}    .key{min-width:0;height:46px}    .key.utility{height:54px}  }</style><script>function buildKeypad(){  els.keypad.innerHTML = "";  const rows = [    "ABCDEF",    "GHIJKL",    "MNOPQR",    "STUVWX",    "YZ"  ];  rows.forEach(keys => {    const wrap = document.createElement("div");    wrap.className = "keyRow";    keys.split("").forEach(k => {      wrap.appendChild(makeKey(k, "key", () => {        addLetter(k.toLowerCase());        focusInput();      }));    });    els.keypad.appendChild(wrap);  });  const controls = document.createElement("div");  controls.className = "keyRow short";  controls.appendChild(makeKey("Backspace", "key utility", backspace));  controls.appendChild(makeKey("Play", "key utility primary", () => play(typed)));  els.keypad.appendChild(controls);}</script>
